verdict.rationale: Mintlify's first-party docs describe a hosted search MCP server for each docs site. AI tools like Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT can connect to it to search and retrieve content from the site, and the pricing page lists 'MCP server' as a platform feature. That directly matches the story. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the exposed tools and their limits (e.g. separate search vs. full-page fetch tools, auth for private docs), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can query a published site's MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my published docs site exposes its own MCP server that my users' agents can query for search and page content

citations.quote: Connect AI tools like Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT to your hosted search MCP server so they can search and retrieve content from your site.
Search Model Context Protocol (MCP) server - Mintlify
